# Dre's Island Food Services

> Jamaican-rooted catering and private events across Tampa Bay and Central Florida, led by Chef Andre "Dre" Christie. Custom-quoted menus with exquisite presentation for weddings, galas, corporate events and private dinners.

## Service styles
- Small Bites: jerk chicken bites, Jamaican cocktail patties, charcuterie skewers
- Drop-off Feasts: hot custom spreads (jerk chicken, oxtail, seafood, island sides)
- Onsite Family-Style: cooked, plated and served at your location
- The Chef's Table: seated fine-dining dinner (e.g. Pineapple Snapper Tropical Bowl)
- Weddings and galas for up to 250 guests; corporate and nonprofit events

## Flavor Oasis
Chef Dre's exclusive tasting experience: five surprise courses inspired by Jamaica, a chance to meet the chef, intimate limited seating and ambient live music. The second edition was held on Saturday, August 1, 2026 at Factory 22, Wesley Chapel, FL. Private tastings can be requested through the quote form.

## Signature dishes
Braised oxtail, jerk chicken, curry goat, ackee & saltfish, jerk wings, escovitch snapper, brown stew snapper, jerk salmon, shrimp pasta, jerk chicken pasta, rice & peas, sweet plantains, festival.

## About the chef
Raised in Jamaica and taught in his grandmother Miss Mavis' kitchen; 20+ years of culinary experience, including time with Sandals Resorts chefs. Nominated for Best Startup by the Pasco County Economic Development Council (2025).

## Reviews
5.0 stars from 15 Google reviews.
